description: TikTok API: List TikTok video comments. Comments of a video with author, likes, reply count, date, pinned and liked-by-creator flags, page by page: follow `pagination.next_cursor`. `meta.total_comments` is TikTok's count. Price: 2 credits per call; failed calls are free. Paginated: pass pagination.next_cursor as `cursor` for the next page (each page is a new call).
name: tiktok_video_comments
title: List TikTok video comments
